intro: Tuvalu's highest point is only about 4.6 m above sea level.

chapters.title: Atolls
text: Funafuti, the capital atoll, has a large lagoon. The total land area is only about 26 km². King tides already flood parts of the islands.

chapters.title: Water
text: Rainwater is collected for drinking, and salt water seeping into the ground harms crops.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Tuvalu's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
